name: Koda window context
description: Tells Koda which window you were using before it (app and title), over the session D-Bus, and — only when Koda asks and only for the window it was just told about — paints that one window into a private file under your runtime directory so Koda can answer questions about it. The extension never sends data to the network, never moves or closes a window, and refuses any caller that has not registered the random token Koda makes on every launch.
